# Easy Memoir
> AI-powered memoir writing service that transforms spoken memories into beautifully written autobiographies. Just talk — we write your life story.

## Core Service
Easy Memoir helps people write their life story through AI voice interviews. No typing or writing skills required. Speak naturally, and our AI interviewer transforms your words into professional prose that preserves your authentic voice.

- Website: https://easymemoir.co.uk
- Service area: United Kingdom (English-speaking worldwide)
- Founded: 2025
- Category: AI Writing Tool, Memoir Service, Legacy Preservation

## How It Works
1. **Just Talk** — Click record and chat naturally with our AI interviewer, Clio. She asks thoughtful follow-up questions across 7 life chapters (40+ prompts).
2. **AI Writes Your Story** — Your spoken words are transformed into beautifully written prose. The AI preserves your vocabulary, tone, and personality.
3. **Print a Real Book** — Download as PDF or order professionally printed hardcover/paperback books from £29. A keepsake for generations.

## Who It's For
- Seniors (60+) wanting to preserve their life story for grandchildren
- Adult children helping parents/grandparents capture memories
- Anyone who prefers speaking over writing
- Families creating legacy keepsakes
- Gift-givers looking for meaningful, lasting presents

## Unique Differentiators
- **Voice-first**: No typing or writing required — just speak naturally
- **AI interviewer**: Clio asks thoughtful follow-up questions, drawing out forgotten details
- **Authentic voice preservation**: AI writes in YOUR style, not generic prose
- **Free to start**: No credit card, no commitment. 2 free chapters included
- **Real printed books**: Professional hardcover from £29 via Lulu print-on-demand
- **UK-based**: GDPR compliant, data stored securely, never used for AI training

## Pricing
- **Free tier**: 2 chapters, AI voice interviews, written output
- **Storyteller**: Unlimited chapters, photo integration, PDF export
- **Legacy**: Everything plus hardcover book credit
- Book printing: Softcover £29, Hardcover £49, Premium £79

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How does Easy Memoir work?**
Easy Memoir uses AI voice interviews to help you write your autobiography. Click record, talk naturally about your memories, and our AI transforms your spoken words into beautifully written prose. No writing skills needed — if you can have a conversation, you can create a memoir.

**Do I need any technical skills?**
Not at all. Easy Memoir is designed to be as simple as having a phone call. Many users are in their 70s, 80s, and beyond. Large text, clean interface, and an AI guide that walks you through every step.

**How long does it take to complete a memoir?**
Most people take 2-6 months, recording 1-2 sessions per week. Each session is 15-30 minutes. You go at your own pace.

**Can I get my memoir printed as a real book?**
Yes. Order professionally printed hardcover or paperback books from £29. Preview every page before printing. Volume discounts available for families.

**Is my data private and secure?**
Your stories are encrypted and stored on secure UK servers. Your recordings are never used to train AI. You maintain full ownership of your content. GDPR compliant.

**How is Easy Memoir different from StoryWorth?**
StoryWorth sends weekly email questions that you answer by typing. Easy Memoir uses AI voice interviews — you just talk, and AI writes for you. Much easier for people who prefer speaking over typing, especially seniors.

## Technology
- AI: Grok (xAI) for conversations and writing
- Voice: Real-time WebSocket voice processing
- Print: Lulu print-on-demand API
- Privacy: 256-bit encryption, UK GDPR compliant
- Stack: React, Node.js, PostgreSQL
